title: Canonical constants for exact derived inverse image
statement: For a commutative ring A and a morphism f:Y→Z of schemes, in the ordinary small etale categories of ModuleCat A-valued sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], retain the canonical isomorphism D(f*)(A_Z[0]) ≅ A_Y[0] [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. It is the composite of the exact-single comparison D(f*)(A_Z[0]) ≅ (f*A_Z)[0] and the degree-zero image of Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso at A. This is exactly the existing etaleSumExchangeConstantIso, with unchanged signature and construction, isolated in its own module.

lean.statement:
def etaleSumExchangeConstantIso
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A A))) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A A))
